preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain control of owner address)
Attacker needs some token balance to demonstrate fee impact

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call updateFee() with extremely high txFee (e.g., 99) and set FeeAddress to your own address. Then perform a token transfer from another account to trigger the fee mechanism, causing a large portion of the transferred amount to be sent to your FeeAddress instead of the intended recipient.
